lines.1: Student council work was rough today.
lines.3: The Princess said she had somewhere to be and took off early.
lines.4: One by one, everyone left until only Sato and I remained.
lines.5: 「We should probably get going too, Sato.」
lines.7: 「Ah, yeah... Um, I'll lock up in a minute, so... l-let's walk home together.」
lines.9: I was genuinely happy to be invited like that.
lines.13: I could at least wash the teacups.
lines.16: But I had already picked up the teacup.
lines.19: We both froze and stared at each other.
lines.24: Neither of us had much to say after that.
lines.30: We left the student council office.
